sources: https://midnrreservations.com/ (Algonac State Park campsites via the booking site's /api/resourcelocation/resources and /api/resource/feeDetails for 2026-10-20, 2027-06-08 and 2027-07-13; audit/state_park_fees/gtc_probe.py, read 2026-10-25)

values.note: 2027 on the booking site (2027-06-08 and 07-13 alike): every site $30; 2026 (Oct 20): $28. A Recreation Passport is required for vehicle entry to all state park and forest campgrounds.

fees.source: https://midnrreservations.com/ feeDetails (Wagon Wheel: one fee schedule for all 76 sites, $30 on 2027-06-08 and 2027-07-13, $28 on 2026-10-20) + https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/algonac ('A Recreation Passport (park pass) is required for vehicle entry into all state park and forest campgrounds'), read 2026-10-25

hookups.source: midnrreservations.com site attributes (all 76 Wagon Wheel sites 'Electric and Water Hookups=Electric Only, Electrical Service=20 Amps/30 Amps, Sewer Hookup=No') + https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/algonac (Wagon Wheel: 'Electrical service'), read 2026-10-25

values.note: Paved pad on each site; three ADA sites. The booking site lists trailers/RVs to 50 ft and over at some sites.

sites.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/algonac (Algonac Modern Wagon Wheel: 'Number of sites: 76', 'features a paved pad on each site', 'three ADA accessible campground sites') + midnrreservations.com resources (equipment to 'Trailer or RV over 50''), read 2026-10-25

facilities.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/algonac (Algonac Modern Wagon Wheel: 'Concession or store', 'Sanitation station', 'Toilet & shower building', 'Vault toilet'; 'There is a sanitation station'), read 2026-10-25

booking.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/algonac (Algonac Modern Wagon Wheel: 'For reservations call 800-447-2757 or reserve online'), read 2026-10-25

note: Modern campground about 0.45 mi inland from Riverfront (the DNR calls the St. Clair River a 10-minute walk), laid out in a circle like a wagon wheel and set back in the woods; more shade and privacy and away from road noise. --Claude
summary: DNR park page + booking site: 76 sites (was 87, from note prose), 20/30 A electric only, paved pads, RVs to 50+ ft, showers/flush and vault toilets/sanitation station, store. Fees 28 (2026 table) -> 30 (2027 booking site; 2026 rate and the Recreation Passport in fees.note). Season (manual) left. Already split from Riverfront. Note's '87-site' corrected out and trimmed of what the fields hold.
